Every autonomous action arrives with proof.

RSFapp is the flight deck for the Recursive State Feedback layer — the evidence layer beneath agent execution. It coordinates the rsf_fleet, watches coherence in real time, and seals every result into a hash-chained, holder-signed ledger. Everything on this page is computed live in your browser — every hash, signature, and coherence figure below is real — and every claim carries its evidence class.

P32 trinity architecture

trinity_mind · hermes_spine · star-of-stars IN BUILD

Thirty-two agents in five tiers under three apex hosts that act as one hive mind only when a claim survives re-verification on any of them. Separation of powers is separation of hosts: no tier self-certifies, and no tier verifies a path it contributed to.

  • APEX · 2 — command apex; sole ioCode issuer, cannot self-certify
  • T3 · 3 — gate / reconcile / record
  • T6 · 6 — six fail-closed gates, all special tier
  • T9 · 9 — converge, record, the hands and the voice
  • T12 · 12 — slice-readers, renderers, red team

roster invariant: exactly thirty-two — a thirty-third requires two-person Sovereign GO + a fresh ioCode band

MB-01
ORCHESTRATE

Composes and proposes. Hosts the hub agent; may never gate, seal, or write the ledger.

MB-02
GATE · VETO POINT

Verifies, quarantines, issues verdicts. May never write the ledger or compose what it certifies.

MB-03
RECORD

Sole ledger writer. Seals, checkpoints, anchors, publishes; may never gate or judge.

Star-of-stars: the apex hosts reconcile only through the spine and the gate, never peer-to-peer, and content never travels — only its digest. A cross-brain claim clears on 2-of-3 matching sealed verdicts; tie or tamper → withhold, never assert.

ALPHA

attunement + heartbeat

THETA

proposals

BETA

commits — the human INVERT lives here

DELTA

sealed evidence + cross-anchors

GAMMA

verdicts and breach only — never decoration

Evidence classes, governed. MEASURED — recorded on real hardware. DEMONSTRATED — working implementation you can exercise on this page. SIMULATED — model output, labeled wherever shown, never presented as measured. DECLARED — a stated wiring point or filing. A sealed lie is still a lie, sealed: the seal proves integrity and authorship, never content truth — which is exactly why every class is printed next to its number.
